summary: COPEL (Companhia Paranaense de Energia) filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors approved an update to the company's optimal capital structure parameters and dividend policy. The update adjusts financial leverage targets (net debt/EBITDA) from 2.8x to 2.9x, with a tolerance range of +0.3x/-0.3x (now 3.2x–2.6x), and extends the convergence period from 24 to 48 months. The policy maintains a minimum dividend payout of 75% of net income, paid at least twice a year. This is a routine capital allocation update, not a special situation event.
